summary: Persistent Chrome-profile cookie auth (auth profile-login / auth refresh) via chromedp, plus a Cookie-header injection in the client.
reason: care.com login is a passwordless magic-link and enforces a single active session, which defeats press-auth's controlled-window flow; a durable profile stays valid for weeks and refresh re-extracts cookies headlessly.
validated_outcome: auth profile-login/refresh wired under the auth parent; live job list authenticated via the cached cookie.
